paragraphs: The stock price of Fermi Inc. is 6.18, with a change of -0.16% from the prior close and -16.03% over a window of 23 sessions. The price is as of August 7, 2026.

Recent news headlines include discussions of the company's CEO departure, expectations for signing agreements with tenants, and retail positioning on the stock. A filing with the SEC disclosed that CEO Toby Neugebauer had left the company as of April 17, 2026, and an Interim Office of the CEO had been set up. The company also shared updates about its Project Matador initiative and reported first-quarter results.

There have been various SEC filings, including the appointment of new officers, the resignation of director Miles Everson, and the issuance of $431.25 million in aggregate principal amount of 5.00% convertible senior notes due 2031. Cetera Investment Advisers also lifted its holdings in shares of Fermi Inc. by 3,262.3% during the first quarter, according to its most recent 13F filing.
